properties.name: Tomačevo Bridge
properties.zag_role: Bridge weigh-in-motion and structural health monitoring
properties.description: Elastomeric bearings at the piers and guided unidirectional pot bearings at the abutments. ZAG, Cestel and Dewesoft Monitoring instrumented the bridge for combined bridge weigh-in-motion and structural health monitoring. A controlled load test in May 2024 ran two pre-weighed calibration trucks over 72 passages across two nights, recording strain, acceleration, temperature and displacement at 500 Hz. During normal operation in March 2023 the system captured a 13-axle vehicle weighing over 200 tonnes.
properties.source_title: Model updating of bridges using measured influence lines

properties.name: Ravbarkomanda Viaduct
properties.zag_role: Long-term structural health monitoring and bridge weigh-in-motion
properties.description: Two parallel structures carrying one direction each, built in 1972 on what is now the Venice to Lviv corridor. ZAG instrumented span P14D of the right-hand viaduct with strain gauges on the bottom flange of four main girders at mid-span, and triaxial accelerometers across several spans for ambient and traffic-induced modal testing. A bridge weigh-in-motion system supplies the traffic loading, and the measured response is used to update a finite element model of the structure. Both viaducts were fully rehabilitated between May 2017 and July 2019, including carbon fibre strengthening of the cantilevers, bearing replacement and a one metre deck widening.

properties.name: Vransko Bridge
properties.zag_role: Bridge weigh-in-motion measurement and direct measurement of dynamic amplification
properties.description: One of the earliest long SiWIM deployments. Strain was recorded continuously for 58 days, from 25 September to 21 November 2006, capturing 147,524 vehicles including roughly 74,000 five-axle articulated trucks. Total and static bending moments at mid-span were separated to measure the dynamic amplification directly from traffic rather than inferring it from a code factor. The work was done with University College Dublin.

properties.name: Novo Mesto Stress Ribbon Footbridge
properties.zag_role: Static and dynamic load testing, and validation of the finite element model
properties.description: The first bridge in Slovenia built with stress ribbon technology. ZAG carried out the load test in March 2023: static loading in three stages, dynamic testing with a light truck driven over artificial obstacles, and ambient vibration measurement. Vertical displacements, natural frequencies and mode shapes were compared against a finite element model and agreed well. The reported deflection was 130 mm under a 70 tonne load. Client was the City Municipality of Novo mesto, built by CGP Novo mesto with Freyssinet Adria, designed by Ponting Bridges and Pipenbaher Consulting Engineers.

properties.zag_role: Structural reuse of salvaged girders
properties.description: Built under the CIRCUIT project, which demonstrates circular practice in construction. properties.name: Verd Viaduct
properties.zag_role: First Slovenian application of an expansive grout additive
properties.description: The first structure on which the Ikaton expansive additive was used for grouting prestressing cable ducts. The additive compensates for the shrinkage of cement grout so that the duct fills completely and the tendon is protected from corrosion. Built by Beograjska Mostogradnja. The additive line was developed at ZAG.

properties.source_title: Transmission and other towers, reference list

properties.position_note: This is not a single structure, so kind stays 'area'. Per SŽ's 'Nova proga' special issue, the February 2014 ice storm hit the overhead line hardest on the Borovnica–Divača section of the Ljubljana–Sežana main line. At Postojna, Logatec and Verd stations, and on the Verd–Logatec and Borovnica–Verd sections, the damage was so severe that a new overhead line had to be built. Lesser damage occurred on the Ljubljana–Jesenice, Ljubljana–Dobova and Zidani Most–Maribor lines. Anchor: Postojna railway station (mapcarta), one of the named worst-hit stations, chosen as a representative point. The line gives the section's extent (Borovnica station from en.wikipedia, Divača station from mapcarta); it is not a structure. The old point (Ljubljana centre) was not on the damaged section. The ZAG source does not say which masts were analysed.

properties.name: Čatež Bridge over the Sava
properties.zag_role: Combined earthquake and flood vulnerability assessment
properties.description: Within the CROSScade project the bridge was selected as the most critical of seven bridges in the Sava reach below the Brežice hydropower plant. Reasons given were its role on a key regional route, the lack of adequate scour protection and a design that predates modern performance-based seismic provisions. The first half of the bridge was modelled in Midas Civil and OpenSeesPy with soil-structure interaction, and fragility curves were derived for sequential ground shaking, flood loading and local pier scour.

properties.position_note: Point is the OSM building 'Moška kaznilnica' (way 154880371, Wikidata Q60348010, inception 1889; mapcarta gives only 4 decimals). It is about 200 m SSW of the old point. The address Pobreška cesta 20 also houses RRA Podravje. 'KPD' originally meant Kazensko poboljševalni dom and is now reused as Kreativni park Drava (Maribor24). Built 1884–1889 and closed in 1963 (Večer). LOCATION CORRECTION: Večer places the complex between Pobreška cesta, Titova cesta and the railway, with Europark (opened 2000) on its north side, so it is not directly on the Drava bank. It also lies ~450 m EAST of the Old Bridge (46.55556, 15.64583), next to Europark by the Titov most bus stop. The input phrase 'between the Old and Railway bridges' therefore looks wrong (more likely between the Railway bridge and Titov most), but I could not open a source with the railway bridge coordinate to confirm. Location text corrected: the building is not on the Drava bank.
